name: Expected-goals model over the exchange total
hypothesis: The independent-Poisson expected-goals model prices a over total more accurately than the exchange does, so buying the over side when the offer is at least 0.040 below the model probability earns the difference.
data_used: kalshi.trade_api KXNHLTOTAL contracts (floor_strike, yes/no offers, candlesticks) + api-web.nhle.com results for expected goals.
entry_rule: At decision time compute expected goals from prior games only; buy the over side of the quoted strike when the offer is at or below model P(over) - 0.040. Strikes outside [4.5, 8.5] are not traded.
price_rule: Require an executable offer <= model P(over) - 0.040; never bet into a stale or missing quote.
settlement_rule: Official NHL final score. Kalshi settles an Over k.5 contract on regulation + overtime goals, with a shootout counted as one goal for the winner -- which is what the official final score already includes, so total = home_score + away_score.
